scope: Independently curated symbolic reference identities for complete compiler function contributions; acceptance and freshness remain in recovery.json gates.
methodology: Callee RVAs/extents come from each pre-existing callee own recovery record and its source/body evidence, never from current caller masked operands.
Each bound callee complete compiler contribution was freshly checked for non-reference byte identity at its own previously recorded native function entry.
Explicit reference offsets/types/addends describe fresh COFF uses; the original encoded destination is checked only after independent binding selection.
Initialized data addresses/extents come from pre-existing source declarations/data ownership manifests, with complete provider payload equality checked independently.
Import names come from SDK decorated import symbols and original PE IAT DLL/name entries.
No callee implementation completeness, original source naming, original link placement, or whole-game equivalence is claimed.
